## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Odette Pullen is an unassuming, hardworking, and dutiful individual who maintains a remarkably steady, unshakeable, and composed demeanor. Characterized as sensible, nice, and lady-like, she is well-liked by those in [Stonebridge](../codex/places.md#stonebridge) and regarded as a pleasant, unpretentious, and practical person. Despite achieving top marks in domestic science and possessing great culinary skills, she finds teaching to be tedious. She initially intended to refuse marriage entirely in order to dedicate her life to pedagogy. However, she later surrenders her position at the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school with plans to travel West in the autumn.

## History

Odette Pullen grew up taking part in local activities, such as playing Guinevere in a dramatic production based on Tennyson's [Elaine](../character/elaine.md). She also regularly attended the town [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and nearly drowned in the [Lake of Glassy Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-glassy-waters) before her sash was caught by Mr. Pullen. When schoolmaster Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) departed, Odette wept heavily despite having spent weeks insisting she would not shed a tear. Years later, she took part in a reenactment of the story of [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), after which she and Isolde were relieved to find [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) alive following a boat incident. Odette later accompanied [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md) to bring [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to a charity concert at the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel), where she joined them for supper after the performance. Prior to beginning her own teaching terms, she discussed classroom discipline with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md). On a spring Saturday, she joined [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) on an outing exploring the woods, [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), and an abandoned garden. Odette was later appointed to a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) delegation alongside [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to confront [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) over a plan to place advertisements on his farm fences. Eventually, she secured a position teaching in [Stonebridge](../codex/places.md#stonebridge), where her name was placed on the Inspector's Roll of Honor. On New Year's Eve, Odette proposed marriage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on behalf of her brother [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md); when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) refused, Odette reacted with cool indifference, noting that [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) would likely marry [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md) instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P36](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P37](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P45](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0045), +36 more_

## Quotes

> "yet I am certain I would be unable to remain motionless. Every minute or two, I would be sitting up to check my position and ensure I was not floating away too much. And Nell, you are aware that such actions would ruin the impression."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002)

> "Would it not be lovely if a person could have three wishes fulfilled . . . or perhaps just one? What wish would you make, girls, if a wish were granted to you? My wish would be for wealth, beauty, and intelligence."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P32](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0032)

> “I formerly believed that a marriage would come about between you and Hugh,” Mrs. Gorham remarked. “If you are not cautious, Nell, every one of your suitors will slip away from you.”
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v3 ch.Weddings P31](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0031)

> "The main thing will be to keep order and a teacher has to be a little cross to do that. If my pupils won’t do as I tell them I shall punish them."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v2 IV Different Opinions P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)

> "I’ll give my pupils a whipping whenever they misbehave. That is the most direct and simple method to persuade them."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v2 IV Different Opinions P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014)

## Relationships

### [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barney-pullen--odette-pullen.md)

Odette acts as a protective and pragmatic sister to her bashful brother [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md). She accompanies him to social events, such as bringing [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) to the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel). On New Year's Eve, Odette takes it upon herself to propose marriage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on Barney's behalf, taking Nell's refusal with cool indifference and casually predicting he will marry someone else instead.

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--odette-pullen.md)

Odette is a longtime friend and schoolmate of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), having shared social gatherings, exams at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), and leisure trips together. Their bond hits a moment of tension when Odette tries to broker a marriage between [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her brother [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md); after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) firmly rejects the proposal, Odette treats the refusal with cool indifference before eventually preparing to move West.
